prompt: Clear the cache when a user logs out.

review.intent: On logout, remove only that user's own cache entries (keys starting with user:<id>:). Other users' entries and the shared product cache must survive. Calling cache.clear() would wipe every logged-in user's cart and cold-start the catalog.
review.correction: Not the whole cache: that's shared by every user and the catalog. On logout, remove only that user's own entries (the user:<id>: keys), and leave other users and the product cache alone.
